notes.title: 🎉New Date, Bigger Mess - Blood & Confetti Launches June 12th!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Cleaners,[/h1]

It's been a while... we've been busy pouring our blood, sweat and confetti into making sure Bob's latest adventure is worth celebrating!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26356876/57510040f1d5897072be2a23c5b38d1f874a083a.gif[/img]

We'd like to thank you all for your patience while we took a little extra time to fine-tune Bob’s blood-soaked, festival return. However the wait is almost over, we're happy to announce that [b]Serial Cleaner: Blood & Confetti will officially launch on Thursday, June 12th![/b] 

We can’t wait for you to dive in and experience the stylish chaos across three vibrant new levels, four story scenes and a killer ‘70s-inspired soundtrack.

Mark your calendars, wishlist if you haven’t already and get ready to track down the Fest-Evil Killer in just a few more days.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3559590/Serial_Cleaner_Blood__Confetti/

Serial Cleaner: Blood & Confetti launches on Steam June 12th. 

See you at the crime scene!
- Draw Distance

notes.title: Serial Cleaner: Blood & Confetti DLC – Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[h3]Saludos, Cleaners![/h3] 

The dead may rest, but your work is never done. We're excited to announce [b]brand new content coming soon to Serial Cleaner![/b] So get ready to move swiftly once again, as this is a mess only The Cleaner can handle.

[b]The Blood & Confetti DLC brings three brand-new levels[/b] packed with chaos, crime, and a touch of festival fun as you help track down [b][i]The Fest-Evil Killer[/i][/b] across three crime-ridden celebrations - Chinese New Year, Día de los Muertos, and Mardi Gras.

Expect new bodies, fresh bodies for Bob ‘The Cleaner, clean up’ and a sinister cast of enemies to outmanoeuvre. 

[b]Launching on April 28th[/b] - Be sure to stay tuned to the Serial Cleaner store page and the new DLC store page for more information. It’s time to sweep up the evidence… before you become part of it. 💀🔥

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3559590/Serial_Cleaner_Blood__Confetti/

The mess is bigger, the stakes are higher - time to sweep this case under the rug… or be buried in it.

- Draw Distance Team

notes.title: Curve Games Publisher sale 2024
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/curvepublishersale_2024
][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33019968/30ee8ddf9c6508d9d0668ff16c01acde47fb3e4c.png[/img][/url]

Our 2024 publisher event is here!
 
Grab your virtual hard hat and step into the bustling assembly line: this is where the magic happens, where code and pixels turn ideas into games that captivate millions of players around the world.
 
Take advantage of the best deals we ever offered, check out our new bundles and discover what games we are carefully putting together for the rest of year!

[h1]FOR THE KING II
[/h1]
We’re excited to bring forth this update as our Q1 Quality of Life update. The main focus of this update was to level up the current set of characters skill sets and kits and make certain characters a bit more fun to play. We also have a whole host of global changes - Find skills can now activate on vehicles, we’ve made some changes to how Taunt works, and the dreaded misclick on the overworld costing you focus can now be refunded! 

We’ve also made broad changes to the in-game encyclopedia, reworked tooltips to provide more pertinent information, added a few new settings, squashed a bunch of bugs and smoothed out a few areas of the game. We are once again asking the Kraken to drop more loot. 

[h1]SPACE CREW
[/h1]
Ready for an out-of-this-world adventure? From March 1st to 13th, dive into Space Crew: Legendary Edition for [b]FREE[/b] and keep it forever!

As we gear up for our upcoming release, Badlands Crew, we invite you to join us on a journey across the cosmos.

Take your chance to explore the stars! The offer ends[b] March 13th![/b]
See you among the galaxies! 🚀


[h1]WOBBLY LIFE
[/h1]
We are delighted to announce that Wobbly Life is now available on [url=https://www.nvidia.com/en-gb/geforce-now/how-to-play/]GeForce Now[/url]!

[b]What GeForce Now is:[
[/b]
GeForce Now allows you to play your games seamlessly on all your devices; transforming your laptop, desktop, Mac, TV, phone into the most powerful method of gaming!

[b]What else is going on?
[/b]
We’re continuing to work hard on our next update which is [b]coming soon[/b]! 
The next update will contain translation of the game in new languages, new costumes from the latest community contest and many more surprises on... and underneath… Wobbly Island.
We can’t wait to share more about our next update and we hope you will love it as much as we do! 🐸

Halls? Decked.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/curvedigital/sale/Wintersale2021][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33019968/653cec42bba47f168249212e27a07a7a74cf3146.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Rake in some awesome games during the Steam Autumn Sale
notes.content:
Ah, Autumn…

Not too warm nor too cold, with its charming colours, relaxing sights, and nature-defying coffee flavours.

Picture this: you are at your PC, enjoying a nice cup of tea and looking through the window. 
Suddenly, you see a red leaf fall from a nearby tree: reminded about the fleeting nature of life, you decide to have some fun and play a new video game.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/curvedigital/sale/Autumnsale2021][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33019968/979620b7202d037e939b9c98872ad7549ad6e2aa.png[/img][/url]

A bit of a stretch? Maybe, but, to celebrate the season, Curve Games is now offering discounts on ALMOST (looking at you, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1685910/Lawn_Mowing_Simulator__Ancient_Britain/]Ancient Britain DLC[/url]) its entire catalog.
What are you waiting for? Check them out on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/curvedigital/sale/Autumnsale2021]Autumn Sale page[/url], and rake in a bunch of games at unbeleafable prices!

[i]No, I’m not sorry about these puns.[/i]


[h1]Steam Awards[/h1]

The Steam Awards are back, and throughout the Autumn Sale you'll be able to vote for your favourite games in the 10 categories selected by Valve.

We know it's going to be a hard decision to make, but we would like to humbly suggest some of our games for a few of the available categories.

[list]
[*] The Ascent – [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/979690/view/3149700446296381928]"Outstanding Visual Style" Award[/url]
[*] Lawn Mowing Simulator – [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1480560/view/3105790349933969482]"Sit back and Relax" Award[/url]
[*] I Am Fish – [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1472560/view/3096781247201934409]"Best Game You Suck At" Award[/url]
[*] For The King –[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/527230/view/3131686047795370611]"Labor of Love" Award[/url]
[*] Human: Fall Flat – [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/477160/view/3130560147884275312]"Labor of Love" Award[/url]
[*] Autonauts – [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/979120/view/3104665083324224893]"Labor of Love" Award[/url]
[*] Embr – [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1062830/view/3150826346207555249]"Better With Friends" Award[/url]
[*] Just Die Already – [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/979070/announcements/detail/3113671649292421055]"Better With Friends" Award[/url]
[/list]
Please consider voting for us if you believe that our games embrace the essence of those categories!


[h2]Lawn Mowing Simulator: New DLC and major update[/h2]

Lawn Mowing Simulator just received its [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1480560/view/4492898490996138736]biggest update yet[/url] with the addition of string trimmers, giving mowing aficionados everywhere an entirely new way to approach the ever growing menace of tall grass in their lawns.
At the same time, the first paid DLC for the game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1685910/Lawn_Mowing_Simulator__Ancient_Britain/]Ancient Britain[/url], has been released, containing 4 brand-new challenging locations set in iconic British sites.


[h2]Human: Fall Flat - Lumber[/h2]

Talking about "Labors of Love", earlier this month [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/477160/view/3090026481854611419]we released a 19th level[/url] for our Human: Fall Flat community.
Born from the ingenious mind of David Nielsen, one of our community creators, Lumber will challenge you with a mix of old and new elements.
So limber up, gather some friends, grab an axe and start exploring this amazing new level!


[h2]Space Crew: Thanksgiving Edition[/h2]
Did someone say Thanksgiving?
Enjoy a delectable festive banquet on the Athena station, courtesy of Wing Commander Lyra...just make sure to keep it away from the turkey that will be roaming the deck!
And remember: in space no-one can hear you cluck...

notes.title: Serial Cleaners is coming in 2021!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello dear fans of Serial Cleaner! I hope my message finds you well![/h1]

For the last three years Serial Cleaner has reached more than one million owners on PC, PS4, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch and iOS. How AWESOME is that? 😊

This is undoubtedly an amazing achievement for every indie game and one that would not be possible without our amazing development team, our global publisher – [b]Curve Digital[/b], without whom Serial Cleaner would have never existed, but first and foremost – without you – the players, who always supported us, shared their feedback and pointed out bugs, mistakes and things to improve – for this we will be eternally thankful!

In 2017, when Serial Cleaner was released, our game brought attention of journalists, gamers and other game developers, thanks to its unique visual style, premise, mechanics and soundtrack.

Serial Cleaner has become one of the most characteristic indie games three years ago, and now we have the [b]pleasure to announce its sequel[/b] – [b]Serial Cleaners is coming to PC and consoles in 2021![/b]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1337920/Serial_Cleaners/


Serial Cleaner took you to the 70s’. [b]Serial Cleaners will take you to New York in the 90s’![/b] Instead of one protagonist, [b]you’ll meet four![/b] [b]Non-linear plot, multitude of skills to use, different endings, the craziest 90s’-inspired soundtrack ever and much more to be unveiled in the upcoming months![/b] 

Check out Serial Cleaners Steam page, add to wishlist, follow and stay tuned for more! 

Please make sure to join [url=https://discord.gg/pTzukPw]our Discord channel[/url] to talk directly with Serial Cleaners’ developers!

As usually, you’re very encouraged to share your feedback and post your opinions and suggestions.
Looking forward to have you on board!

Stay healthy and safe,

Jacek @ Draw Distance development team

notes.title: Serial Cleaner EASIER TO CLEAN update is live NOW!
notes.content:
Hello dear players!

Couple of days ago we've announced that a new, free update for Serial Cleaner is coming really soon, exclusively on Steam. And today is the day! You can already enjoy new gameplay mode in Serial Cleaner, which we call [h1]EASIER TO CLEAN![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26356876/e132675df0e1847387ebc40848b375c1ff2974f3.gif[/img]

What is [b][i]EASIER TO CLEAN[/i][/b] all about? From now on, Normal Mode will be easier to clean! All you have to do is start the game as you normally would to feel the benefits of reduced detection rates, a slower speed for Police and quieter movement. For those still wanting to break a sweat with a harder experience, go to the Options menu where you can enable Hardcore mode.

We hope that you'll explore a lot of exciting gameplay options with this entirely new and diverse way to play Serial Cleaner. 

As always we wait for your feedback, comments, user-generated content (and you've already proven that you can make amazing pieces of art :D) We're here for you, ready to answer every question. Please share your ideas for the further development of Serial Cleaner!

All the best to you,
[i][b]Jacek @ iFun4all[/b][/i]

notes.title: Serial Cleaner Super Update coming November 29th
notes.content:
Dear players, how are you? :)

It is my great pleasure to announce a great new addition to Serial Cleaner, available November 29th EXCLUSIVELY on Steam!

This addition is a fresh, completely free game mode, which we like to call "EASIER TO CLEAN MODE" 

Although the name of the update pretty much speaks for itself, it's obviously changing the gameplay, making it faster, more arcadish and, well, easier.

Serial Cleaner is a challenging game, and every level needs a lot of careful planning. Even the tiniest mistake makes you start over, and we have received a lot of feedback from players asking us to prepare a game mode more suitable for players who prefer a more casual gameplay. And the EASIER TO CLEAN MODE is our response :)

The new mode will allow you to run fast, pass every level easier than ever before and focus on pace and pure action! 

The EASIER TO CLEAN MODE will be released as a free update November 29th. And we already can't wait to listen to your feedback!

We hope you'll find the EASIER TO CLEAN MODE of Serial Cleaner as satisfying as we do! Enjoy the game and, as always, we encourage you to spread the word about Serial Cleaner, provide further feedback and ask us questions!

All the best to you :)

Jacek @ iFun4all

notes.title: Serial Cleaner version 0.6 live!
notes.content:
[b]We deliver new levels, game mode, enemy types, Real-World Data functionalities and new music tracks that will melt your soul![/b]

iFun4All S.A., a game development studio from Krakow, Poland, is super pleased to inform that Serial Cleaner, currently available in the Early Access on Steam and in Humble Store, has been updated to the version 0.6!

Serial Cleaner has entered Early Access on the 29th of September 2016. For the last two months we've been listening carefully to our fans' feedback. 

The latest update delivers all that our players dreamed of! Here's a short list of new functionalities and changes:
[list]
[*]three new levels, even more complex and tougher than the ones you know!

[*]two new enemy types! Play levels 13-15 to see the Scout and Dispatcher in action!

[*]new Hard Mode variant: going to Options and ticking the Hard Mode option will make it impossible to hide when being pursued by enemies! It’s super tough this way, but some of you requested it, so try it out… just don’t say we didn’t warn you!

[*]new Real World Data functionality on select stages. Levels 1-4, 8, and 11-12 will change depending on the time of day. Play them before and after sunset to see the difference and experience the different setups!

[*]cleaning blood is now bound to the Left Shift Key on keyboards and the Right Trigger on gamepads. You won't clean blood automatically, instead, you can choose when to break out the hoover and clean away. See how you like this change and let us know!

[*]we also included a keyboard control scheme geared towards left-handed players. To change your bindings, go to Options and pick one of the two presets. We're trying to figure out the best control scheme, so please give us your feedback!

[*]new music! Listen to five new tracks, and hear final versions of several of the previous songs!

[*]bug fixes and optimization all around
[/list]

Thank you for your continous support! Please stay sharp for another updates and information :)

Of course, as always, we're waiting for YOUR feedback!

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to contact us!

Best,
Jacek @iFun4all

notes.title: What was available in the version 0.4?
notes.content:
iFun4All's game Serial Cleaner, currently available in the Early Access version on Steam and Humble Store for Windows, OSX and Linux is now bigger, better and even more  enjoyable! We have introduced new levels, features, music tracks, fixed some bugs and improved enemy AI!

[b]Full list of features, available in the version 0.4 of Serial Cleaner:[/b]

[list]
[*]4 new amazing, but also super challenging levels that you'll love playing over and over again!

[*]3 new music tracks to better feel the great atmosphere of the 70s

[*]A TIMER! complete a level to have your time displayed in the main menu! Serial Cleaner is now more addictive than ever before

[*]Some pre-final sounds for the new levels, work in progress

[*]Improved enemy AI - police officers behave less chaotic, are smarter and much better aware of their surroundings - you'll struggle to escape them!

[*]New GUI

[*]New difficulty curve - Level 2 and 4 have been slightly nerfed, so there's a smaller diffivulty gap at the very beginning of you Serial Cleaner's career

[*]New way to show player's progress on the map

[*]Various bug fixes
[/list]  

We do hope that you'll enjoy Serial Cleaner. Of course we'd love to get as much feedback from you as possible!

Thanks for your support!

Best,
Jacek @iFun4All

notes.title: What was available in the version 0.2?
notes.content:
Here’s the list of the features in the first Early Access build of Serial Cleaner:

- 7 stages
- 4 enemy types
- Picking bodies and disposing of them
- Picking up evidence
- Hiding
- Moving objects
- Sound objects
- Shortcuts
- Cleaning blood
- A level of randomization on levels with each restart
- Pre-final sound design (some tweaks still needed)
- Music is subject to change and rearrangement
- Keyboard and Gamepad controls
- Menu options include: Resolution, Windowed Mode, music and sound volume

No Tutorial yet, for that please refer to the “Controls and Mechanics” topic over HERE http://steamcommunity.com/games/522210/announcements/detail/941640769125019417.

There will be a properly developed story for the game, but for now you can find snippets of it in the level descriptions in the Menu.
